successors.name: Nobatia
successors.text: Lower Nubia: "During Silko's reign Nobatia defeated the Blemmyes to the North"

ledger.x: Late 4th century: the Blemmyes hold Lower Nubia and Kalabsha.
About 450: Silko drives the Blemmyes out of Lower Nubia.
About 450: the Blemmyan kingdom on the Nile ends; the people continue in the Eastern Desert (Beja).

wars.name: Silko's war against the Blemmyes
wars.outcome: Nobatian victory; the Blemmyes driven into the Eastern Desert, according to Silko's own inscription at Kalabsha.

certainty.note: Nomadic Eastern Desert people; the Nile holdings are known only from the 298 treaty and later inscriptions.
